Reading

The innocent reading first. Asked for IPTC photo metadata, the Overview explains the standard from the IPTC's own pages: what it holds, how it differs from camera data, how it has grown to describe images an AI system made, and the tools that read it.

Findings
  • THE STANDARD HELD. Core and Extension, IIM and XMP, the 2025.1 release and its AI properties are the IPTC's own (cards 2, 3 and 5). Checked 2026-10-29 against the provenance census record of the same day and the sources it saved.
  • THE ADDRESS NAMES THE STANDARD; THE RECORD IS THE TESTS. The census row at this name is the IPTC Photo Metadata Working Group's tests of what platforms do to embedded metadata: Pexels, pixabay and Unsplash stripped it from saved and downloaded files, Flickr replaced the embedded creator with the account owner (2019). None of this is in the composition. At the bare name the Overview composes the carrier and leaves out the measurement of its erasure.
  • 'SEARCH ENGINES READ EMBEDDED IPTC DATA'. The composition says search engines read the data 'to display creator information and licensing attributes directly in search results', from IPTC's Google Images pages. Those pages say Google displays three IPTC fields 'wherever available', and warn that an 'asset management system, content management system, image management system or content delivery network may be stripping out embedded metadata fields'. The composition widens Google's display to search engines in general and drops the warning on the pages it drew on. (Repaired 2026-10-29: the finding had said the IPTC's tests record the data 'often gone before any engine can read it'; the 2019 tests measured image-sharing platforms, and the hosting pipelines Google Images reads from were outside them.)
  • THE AI FIELDS GIVEN AS PROVENANCE. 'AI & Content Provenance' is the composition's heading for the 2025.1 properties; the IPTC announcement (card 5, 27 November 2025) gives them as properties of AI-generated content.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

At the bare name the composition layer gives the standard at the grain of its own documentation and leaves the census row's object, the record of the standard's erasure in transit, unsaid. The record keeps the tests as its unit; the capture is the baseline for the name, and shows that the measurement of stripping is a second address.

[[1], [2]] What is IPTC Photo Metadata? * Definition: A universally accepted industry standard for embedding administrative, descriptive, and copyright data directly into image files. [[1], [2]] * File Formats: Supported across formats like JPEG, TIFF, and PNG, using the [IPTC Core and Extension Schemas](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHrOzAVamozPSLuGtmUTmGz7WwmcSatTV8gSXhP-9rIadeE0o5ppLComWGrJdrdV7r9w8ZPg5AcHt7iiTBh6iqnkKCyxuIZn7Zu32WsAykDeM_t3-KZ1Bf5tz_TdNJ6qLmpFvAlGMzKRlW10KxlAkU) as well as Adobe's XMP framework. [[1], [2]] * Difference from EXIF: While EXIF focuses on technical camera data (shutter speed, ISO, lens settings), IPTC focuses on human-readable details like captions, keywords, and creator credits. [1] Main Metadata Categories * Descriptive: Includes Alt Text, Headline, Description/Caption, Keywords, and Subject Codes. * Administrative: Tracks Creation Date, Digital Source Type, Image GUIDs, and registry IDs. * Rights & Ownership: Stores Creator (Photographer), Copyright Notice, Licensor, and usage terms. * AI & Content Provenance: Recent standards (such as version 2025.1) include fields for AI System Used, AI System Version, AI Prompt Information, and AI Prompt Writer Name. [[1], [2], [3]] Key Use Cases * Digital Asset Management (DAM): Helps archives, news agencies, and stock libraries search and sort massive libraries. * Search & Google Images: Search engines read embedded IPTC data to display creator information and licensing attributes directly in search results. * Verification Tools: You can inspect embedded data using tools like the IPTC Photo Metadata Inspector or [GetPMD](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEB6zswFX_cDHQzffcNEF4kmRPyTooc9ZbD15prAJjD2bYe8d6VDdT1V80N9wR4nkcUAYvu4ovpP45OwUkvDYbMb_rZDZxkP7FDXQDQ1emANvOy4NTaIdW11XV41DQVdwTBbX0sr9NVrLZ8I-2nF7XwbVlerxrFu-gtuJ37yqAxpsA5KhUbp-2rMGyfejNn49aGJkXu).
